note: The outside challenger's tool posture (unit BRIDGE-POSTURE, 2026-09-23). The challenger audits the case file it is sent and nothing else: web search and the connected apps are switched off on its command line. Before every paid call the unpaid probe asks it for its tool list; a tool whose name carries one of forbidden_tool_classes as a whole word refuses the paid call. After the call, every tool call its event stream shows is recorded by name; a call not in payload_reading_calls marks the challenge posture_breach and the sitting proceeds unaudited. evidence_audit_reads_the_web keeps the evidence auditor's web reader (spec U2.1, the source_doubt finding) until the owner rules; false switches it off like the verdict challenge's. The sub-agent and image-viewing tools stay listed on codex 0.156.0 whatever switch is passed, run inside the same sandbox, and are enforced after the call by the event record, not before it. Image generation is banned by its generation words, so the local image viewer stays allowed.
